Messages.Author: Juggernaut1981
Messages.Body:
@Pascal:
Others have attempted to find a more recent than 2001 ruling by LSJ. It seems to imply that CoT will remove the NRA taint.

Does Change of Target "wash off taint" for the purposes of the No Repeat Actions rule. Such as:

Minion A declares a Bleed action. Minion B attempts to block. Minion A plays Change of Target.

Can Minion A now declare another bleed action (with a different name to the previous bleed action)?

Retired Baron of Sydney, Australia, 418

Messages.Author: Izaak
Messages.Body:
Huh?

NRA kicks in on resolution of the action, successful or not.

Change of Target doesn't say it cancels the action. It says it *ends* the action unsuccessful. If the action has ended, it means it reached resolution, so if it was a bleed/vote action, you can't try again. I realize the card text on Change of Target is somewhat redundant with this interpretation, but we can just throw that on the pile of reminder text.

Compare to Tangle, which specifically says it *cancels* the action.

(Also, if LSJ's 2001 ruling stands, this is clearly a case of a card in need of errata)

Messages.Author: Klaital
Messages.Body: CoTs text is not redundant, because it means the minion can't attempt even normally repeatable actions again (like hunting), but yes, Change of Target is played when the action is -blocked- which means the action reached resolution, and thus the normal NRA rules also apply.

Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body:
> Juggernaut1981 wrote:
> @Pascal:
> Others have attempted to find a more recent than 2001 ruling by LSJ. It seems to imply that CoT will remove the NRA taint.
>
> Does Change of Target "wash off taint" for the purposes of the No Repeat Actions rule. Such as:
>
> Minion A declares a Bleed action. Minion B attempts to block. Minion A plays Change of Target.
>
> Can Minion A now declare another bleed action (with a different name to the previous bleed action)?
>
No. The action is blocked (per Change of Target's text), thus the NRA kicks in.

You can't play another base Govern the Unaligned, nor can't you play a Computer Hacking, if you somehow untap.

Please give a reference to LSJ's link regarding Change of Target not tainting the action with NRA.
In  [LSJ 20010512] , "the action kicks in if it is successful" should be read as "applying the terms of an action kicks in if it is successful".

Blocked actions trigger NRA (it wasn't the case back in Jyhad-times, but it is now, and it has been for more than 10 years).

Tangle Atropo's Hand cancels the action before resolution ("when a minion attempts to block"), which means we didn't reach resolution, and that the same minion can attempt the same action this turn.
